evidence: In 3d_top, 3d_iso and 3d_iso_back every body (terminal block, SOIC-8, inductor, SOT-223, headers, passives) has visible board surface between it and its neighbors with no intersecting or stacked bodies.
Both iso views show all bodies seated flush on the PCB with no floating, sunken, or tilted parts; the terminal block's overhang past the edge is its normal wire entry.

Zoomed 3d_top shows the two two-pad footprints below D1 (R1/R2 in the 2D view) are bare pads with no component bodies at all, so body-on-pads cannot be confirmed for them; all other bodies are centered on their footprints.

Terminal block J1 sits at the board edge with its wire opening facing outward, headers J2/J3 are upright near the opposite edge, no relays exist, and the lone polarized part D1 follows the left-to-right power flow.
No RF module or antenna keepout exists on this board, so the check is not applicable.

The buck chain reads as an ordered bottom row, but the regulator group is scattered: C4 floats far above U2, C5/C6 sit offset to the right, C2 hangs below, J3 is stranded toward the corner, and the entire upper half of the board is dead space.
